newsitem.title: CROATIA: CROATIA MONEY MARKET RATE DROPS TO 9.3 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: CROATIA MONEY MARKET RATE DROPS TO 9.3 PERCENT.

text.p: Croatia average money market rate dropped to 9.3 percent on Tuesday from 10.3 percent, as demand for term loans subsided.
Daily trade was halved, with a total of 34.3 million kuna deals closed. Fresh loans accounted for 23.5 million kuna.

The interbank call money rate remained steady at 7.0 percent. Term loans were granted at between 8.5 percent for rolled over one-week funds and 18 percent, charged for two-month deals with savings banks.
Insurers rolled over one-week funds at 7.0 percent.
The kuna midrates for Wednesday eased to 6.6217 against the dollar and to 3.5631 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
